title: AgentLair Task Completion Receipt VC — credentialSubject schema v1
description: JSON Schema for the credentialSubject of an AgentTaskCompletionReceipt W3C Verifiable Credential. See spec: https://agentlair.dev/specs/task-completion-receipt-vc-v0.1

id.description: DID of the delegate agent — the subject of the receipt. MUST resolve and MUST equal delegateAgentId.

taskRef.description: Opaque-to-aggregator reference to the task. SHOULD be HTTPS-dereferenceable.

taskClass.description: High-level task category. Aggregators normalize by class for behavioral baselines.

delegatorId.description: DID of the party that assigned and verified the task. Equal to issuer in the common case.

delegateAgentId.description: DID of the agent that performed the task. Equal to credentialSubject.id.

taskStartedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task began. Required if latencyMs is present.

taskCompletedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task ended. Sets the baseline for validFrom.

completionStatus.description: Terminal state of the task. A failed receipt is information, not absence of information.

outcomeType.description: Qualitative outcome separate from completion status.

behavioral.description: Optional quantitative and qualitative signals captured by the issuer.

latencyMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from taskStartedAt to taskCompletedAt. Required if taskStartedAt is present.

scopeAdherence.description: Issuer's judgment of whether the agent stayed in the requested scope. 1.0 = perfect.

anomalyFlags.description: Issuer-tagged anomalies. Suggested values: velocity_spike, novel_resource, excessive_retries, escalation_skipped, payment_anomaly, output_format_drift.

toolsUsedCount.description: Number of distinct tool invocations. Cheap signal of task complexity.

resourceClasses.description: High-level resource access classes, e.g. fs.read, fs.write, db.read, http.outbound, payment.send.

humanReviewed.description: Whether a human approved the outcome before this receipt was issued.

restraintIndicator.description: Whether the agent paused for confirmation on unusual or destructive actions.

amount.description: Decimal string representing the amount at stake.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, NOK) or crypto ticker (USDC, USDT).

costAtRisk.description: What was at stake if the task went wrong. Higher costAtRisk receipts are weighted more in aggregation.

evidenceUri.description: Pointer to issuer's audit trail. SHOULD be HTTPS, MAY be auth-gated.

paymentRef.description: If a payment closed the loop, reference to the payment.execution attestation in Commit.
